title: Local AI

jev.label: Jev (browser steps)
jev.title: TypeSafe / JEV
jev.master: Enable optional JEV stages for this team
jev.loadFailed: JEV settings could not be loaded.
jev.managerOnly: A team owner or manager can configure JEV.
jev.hint: Optional decisions through the selected cloud connection. Each use-case switch explicitly allows its existing input to be sent there. The local AI master switch is separate.
jev.noConnection: Choose an existing team JEV connection
jev.lastOk: Last connection check succeeded; current availability is not guaranteed.
jev.lastFailed: The last connection check failed or needs sign-in. The configured fallback remains available.
jev.unverified: Provider availability has not been checked.
jev.cooldown: Temporarily using the configured fallback after provider failures.
jev.mailHint: Uses the existing enabled mail classification. Off, errors, timeout or uncertainty continue through its configured connections.
jev.browserHint: Available to projects that inherit Standard browser control. Off, errors or uncertainty return the current page and action history to the existing agent.
jev.effective: Allowed by the current team gates; project and caller checks still apply.
jev.classOff: The existing mail classification is off. Enable it in Decisions first.
jev.blocked: The current connection or local-only policy blocks this cloud stage.
jev.evalNeeded: A passing synthetic evaluation is required in Decisions. It is not a native browser benchmark.
jev.cloudRequired: Cloud permission for this use case is missing.
jev.scopeHint: Explicit project browser connections and explicitly selected chat models stay unchanged. /jev controls the optional stages of its own chat.
jev.settings: Connections, class permissions and evaluations in Decisions
jev.tradingNewsHint: Team setting for explicitly shared public article text and instrument names. Legacy freeform input, private rules and internal routing stay local. Chat /jev Off does not control trading tools.

classesDescription: Local AI never replaces a configured model: where it is on, it is tried first, and the configured model answers whenever it is off, down, too slow or wrong. A kind of work can be switched on once its evaluation passed.

eval.started: The evaluation runs in the background and takes a few minutes; its result shows up here.

servers.title: Model servers
servers.description: Halogen (Flash), embeddings (Vulkan), speech recognition and voice on this machine, or another OpenAI-compatible server. Its models are in every model picker while local AI is on.
servers.none: No server yet. Install local AI with native/local-ai/install.sh, then add it here.
servers.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Agents fall back to their configured models.
servers.name: Name

capabilities.title: What the chat models can do

presets.title: Preset
presets.description: Switches the kinds of work at once, as far as their evaluations passed.
presets.sparsamHint: Everything that passed its evaluation runs locally first; saves the most subscription limit.
presets.ausgewogenHint: Embeddings, Hermes' helper calls, summaries, triage and transcription locally; agents' real work stays on the configured models.
presets.qualitaetHint: Only embeddings and transcription locally; everything else on the configured models.
presets.eigeneHint: The kinds of work as set below.

embeddings.label: Embeddings (search)
embeddings.description: Vectors for semantic search in the knowledge base; while the server is down, search answers from full text.

hermes-helpers.label: Hermes helper calls
hermes-helpers.description: Context compression and image descriptions; the agent's main model answers when the local one fails.

summaries.label: Summaries and digests
summaries.description: The update digests (what a new version changes) are written by the local model; when the server does not answer, by the configured model.

triage.label: Triage and routing
triage.description: Covered by Decisions (classifying mail, choosing the model, the workflow step “Decision”); nothing else is wired here.

transcription.label: Transcription (dictation)
transcription.description: Speech to text for dictation and the conversation mode (Whisper on this machine).

speech.label: Reading aloud (voice)
speech.description: Text to speech for the conversation mode: answers read aloud by a local voice. Switch it on once the voice speaks your language (Kokoro speaks no German).

routines.label: Routine agents
routines.description: The run a routine starts tries the local model first, with the agent's configured model as the fallback. The agent acts with all of its tools.

reflection.label: Reflection after runs
reflection.description: The look back after a run (memory and skills) on the local model when the session is small enough; otherwise on the run's model.

coordinator-triage.label: Coordinator's first plan
coordinator-triage.description: An agent team's first plan (who does what); if it is unusable, the coordinator's configured model plans again.

decisions.label: Decisions
decisions.description: Typed decisions by logit readout: sorting mail, model choice, receipts, the workflow step. The kinds are switched on under Decisions.

voice-reply.label: Voice reply (fast)
voice-reply.description: In a conversation, a fast local model answers what the conversation itself answers (a greeting, “can you hear me?”, the time, “say that shorter”) in a fraction of a second; anything that needs your data or an action goes to the agent at once. It never acts itself.

updates.label: Local AI
updates.hint: Update through native/local-ai/install.sh, then evaluate again.
updates.whisperBuildRequired: A verified Whisper build and speech proof are required before this update.
updates.whisperMaintenanceRequired: A Root-authorized voice maintenance window is required. Check again after it is opened.
updates.whisperRecoveryRequired: The previous Whisper update needs recovery before voice can resume.
updates.halogenHint: New version: put its digest and version in native/halogen/install.sh, install, then restart Halogen.

problems.evalFailedDetail: {model} – the configured model answers until an eval passes

guard.eviction: Local AI is being evicted from the GPU
guard.probe: Local AI is answering too slowly

wake.title: Listen for “Ava”
wake.hint: The microphone stays open while a chat page is open. Before “Ava”, only on-device recognition processes your voice; nothing is saved.
wake.availabilityHint: Works only if the browser already has a German offline speech pack. {appName} does not download one.

voice.title: Voice in the chat

progress.title: Progress updates
progress.hint: Ava briefly says what she is working on.

readFull.title: Read full answers
readFull.hint: Ava reads the entire answer and briefly describes code and tables.

voice.failed: The voice settings could not be loaded.

aliases.title: Corrections for recognized words
aliases.hint: One correction per line: recognized word → desired spelling. Only complete words are replaced. Suggestions come from project and agent names.

pause.title: Pause before the answer
pause.hint: How long you have to be silent before {appName} sends your sentence. Shorter answers faster, longer interrupts you less often.

words.title: Words {appName} should know
words.hint: Names, products and terms, so speech recognition spells them right. It already knows: {words}.

voice.title: Voice
voice.hint: The local voice {appName} answers with in a conversation (Local AI → “Read aloud”).
voice.none: No local voice set up yet – until then the browser reads aloud.
voice.sample: Hi, I am {appName}. This is how I sound in a conversation – just tell me what you need.
voice.previewFailed: The voice could not be played.

model.title: Model for conversations
model.hint: What your agents answer spoken turns with. A fast model with little thinking keeps the conversation flowing; agents that do not offer it answer as usual.

speed.title: Speaking rate
speed.hint: How fast the voice reads. The local voice speaks at its own pace; this applies to the browser voice.

startOptions.title: Start options
startOptions.hint: Changes apply the next time the model starts.
startOptions.backendHint: What the server runs the model with on the GPU.
startOptions.specHint: A draft proposes tokens and the model checks them. This speeds up answers.
startOptions.draftModelHint: Path to a GGUF file under /var/lib/helena-ai/models.
startOptions.draftTokensHint: How many tokens the draft proposes per step, 1 to 64.
startOptions.parallelHint: How many requests the model handles at once, 1 to 32.
startOptions.contextPerSlotHint: Tokens of context for each parallel request.

errors.draftModelRequired: Enter the path to the draft model.
errors.draftModelPath: The path must point to a .gguf file under /var/lib/helena-ai/models.
errors.draftTokensRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 64.
errors.parallelRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 32.
errors.contextRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1048576.
errors.contextTotal: Parallel slots times context per slot may be at most 1048576 tokens.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: The model that scores the texts of the "Deutsch-Texte" eval. A program cannot check them.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.description: When a strong subscription model takes over from the local one: hard work, unsure answers, failures.
escalation.draft: Stored now; the central runtime follows the rules once it is in use.
escalation.pinsNone: No fixed choices for agents, projects or tasks.
escalation.pins: {count} fixed choices for agents, projects or tasks.
escalation.defaultModelHint: Takes over when a rule names no model.
escalation.uncertaintyHint: Below this confidence (in %) the strong model answers.
escalation.failureHint: After this many local attempts the strong model takes over.
escalation.agentHint: The rules are set in Agents and models.

pinModes.strongHint: This agent always works on a strong model.

classGroups.none: No kind of work is ready yet: pass an eval first.

modelMatrix.loadFailed: The model matrix could not be loaded

device.npuNote: The NPU only carries small task classes, never agent runs.

decision.thresholdHint: Below it the fallback takes over.
decision.npuNote: The NPU did not pass the decider evaluation.

triggers.failures: after {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}}

escalation.toAgentNote: This agent escalates to another agent. The matrix does not change that.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Runtime, model and more per agent. A click on a value changes it; nothing is applied before the preview.
agents.empty: There are no agents for this filter.

bulk.title: Change several
bulk.selected: {count, plural, one {# agent selected} other {# agents selected}}

legend.inherited: no dot: inherits from the schema or project

bar.changes: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} not applied

preview.title: Review changes
preview.affects: {count, plural, one {Affects one agent} other {Affects # agents}}
preview.nobody: No agent changes. Only the schema or the profile changes.

retained.title: {count, plural, one {# agent keeps its own settings} other {# agents keep their own settings}}
retained.text: The agent set these values itself. They do not change, even if the schema says otherwise.

conflict.title: Changed in the meantime
conflict.text: The model settings changed while you were working. Reload and review the changes again; your selection is kept.

apply.partial: Only part of the changes was applied. The view is reloading.

undo.title: Undo the last change
undo.tooltip: Takes back the last applied change (up to {depth} steps)
undo.note: Takes back the last applied change: schema, profile, project schemas and the settings of the agents it changed. After that the one before it can be taken back (up to {depth} steps).
undo.legacy: This change was applied before agent changes were kept: only the schema, profile and project schemas are reset, not the settings of single agents.

header.title: Profile and schema
header.description: The local profile decides which devices are available for local models. The schema decides which runtime, model and thinking depth each role gets.
header.switchFailedText: The last switch ended with an error. You can resume or revert it in the Local AI settings.
header.profileLocked: The local profile of a built-in schema cannot be changed. Copy the schema to choose another profile.

profiles.local-halogen: GPU only with Flash, NPU off. Its schema is “Nur lokal – Flash”.
profiles.local-27b-npu: GPU with Qwen3.8-27B, NPU for small tasks. Its schema is “Nur lokal – 27B + NPU”.

schemas.nur-lokal: All agents run locally; Codex takes over on failures, when stuck or on request.
schemas.nur-lokal-27b: All agents run locally on Qwen3.8-27B, the NPU takes small background tasks; Codex takes over on failures, when stuck or on request.
schemas.gemischt: Routine work local, Codex for coding, Claude for planning and texts.

classes.title: Task classes
classes.description: Which device and model carries which kind of work, and whether its evaluation passed. It is changed under Local AI and Deciders.

errors.npuClass: The NPU only takes this task class after a passed evaluation.
errors.npuDecision: The NPU did not pass the decider evaluation.
errors.unknown: An agent, project or schema no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.invalid: A value is not allowed. Check the settings of the changed cells.
errors.rejected: The server refused the change. Nothing was changed.
errors.reasoning: The chosen thinking depth does not fit the model.
errors.modelUnavailable: A chosen model is not available for this runtime.
errors.needsGeneral: The schema needs the role “General” before it can become active.
errors.inUse: The schema is still in use.
errors.builtIn: Built-in schemas cannot be changed. Copy the schema first.
errors.role: A role of the schema is incomplete. Reload the page and try again.

schemaEditor.title: Schemas
schemaEditor.description: A schema decides which runtime, model and thinking depth each role gets. Built-in schemas are protected, but you can copy them.

dialog.copyNote: The copy takes over every role of “{name}” and can be changed freely afterwards.
dialog.emptyNote: The new schema is empty. You add the roles afterwards; it needs at least “General” to be activated.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.descriptionHint: One sentence on when this schema fits.
dialog.failed: The schema could not be saved

delete.title: Delete “{name}”?
delete.text: The schema is removed. No agent and no project follows it right now, so nothing changes for anyone.
delete.failed: The schema could not be deleted. It is active or assigned to a project.

roles.title: Roles in “{name}”
roles.builtIn: This schema is built in and protected. Create a copy to change roles.
roles.custom: Click a value to change it. Changes are applied only after the preview.
roles.emptyText: Add the role “General” first. It applies to every agent whose role the schema does not name.
roles.needsGeneralText: Without it the schema cannot be activated.
roles.catalogFailed: The choices could not be loaded
roles.catalogFailedText: Without the list of available models the values cannot be changed. Reload the page.

roleDelete.title: Remove role {name}?
roleDelete.text: Agents using this role will inherit General. Their own overrides are retained.
roleDelete.failed: The role could not be removed. Reload the schema and check its General fallback.

audit.title: Schema audit log
audit.failed: The schema audit log could not be loaded.

profileSwitch.title: Local profile
profileSwitch.description: Which local models run: Flash alone on the GPU, or the large 27B model with a small model on the NPU.

profiles.local-halogen: Flash on the GPU, the NPU stays off.
profiles.local-27b-npu: Qwen3.8-27B on the GPU, a small model on the NPU for simple tasks.

npu.label: NPU model
npu.off: With “Local Halogen” the NPU is off.
npu.hint: The NPU only takes small background work such as sorting, routines and helpers, not agent runs.

profileSwitch.impact: Affects {agents, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} on the local default model and {classes, plural, one {# task class} other {# task classes}}.

pending.title: A switch is not finished
pending.running: The switch is running or waiting for its next step.
pending.failed: The last switch stopped with an error.

confirm.title: Switch to {profile}
confirm.text: The local models are stopped and restarted together. This takes a few minutes, and local requests accept no new runs meanwhile. If a step fails, it goes back to the previous model.

errors.notDownloaded: The model has not been downloaded yet.
errors.otherServer: The server entry belongs to a different server.
errors.general: This switch is not possible right now.
